title: Basic hiragana: Vowels and K row — find the sign
description: Choose the written sign from three visible kana using a basic sound or specified spelling context. 10 independent targets.

review.provenance: Independently authored F05 sign exercises and explanations; no CSV or mock curriculum reused.
review.rightsBasis: Original agent-authored English copy and glosses; basic kana correspondences are linguistic facts. No third-party text, recordings, or audio used.

exercises.prompt: Which hiragana sign has the basic reading conventionally written a in romaji?

text.gloss: Hiragana sign for the basic a reading.
Hiragana sign for the basic i reading.
Hiragana sign for the basic u reading.

exercises.explanation: あ is the hiragana spelling for this target. Hiragana sign for the basic a reading. Other spellings are not interchangeable just because a sound can overlap in context.
